items.change: Added a Prisma config file containing the schema, migrations path, and datasource URL; removed the datasource URL from schema.prisma.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 moves datasource URLs out of schema.prisma and supports prisma.config.ts.
items.required_rule: S: datasource url is no longer accepted in schema.prisma in v7

items.change: Removed engineType = "client" from the Prisma client generator block.
items.responds_to: The Prisma 7 client generator changed engine configuration defaults and support.
items.required_rule: S: the engineType generator option is gone with the Rust-free v7 client

items.change: Switched DMMF typing to @prisma/generator-helper, introduced SchemaEnumWithValues, and normalized enum values from Prisma's changed enum representations before generation.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 changed the DMMF enum shape and the runtime package used for DMMF types.
items.required_rule: D: the generator failed on v7's changed DMMF enum shape
S: adapter and explicit env loading are required in v7 (dev/test dependencies)

items.change: Added shared Prisma-generation helpers that remove datasource url and driverAdapters entries, create provider-specific prisma.config.mjs files, and invoke prisma generate with --config; updated affected tests to use them.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7's config-file datasource handling and changed driverAdapters/schema behavior.
items.required_rule: S: tests' generated schemas need prisma.config and no schema url in v7

items.change: Increased generation and minimal-configuration test timeouts.
items.responds_to: Slower generation under Prisma 7 driver-adapter execution.
items.required_rule: D: tests timed out under v7 generation

items.change: Added a local Prisma internals type augmentation making ignoreEnvVarErrors optional on GetConfigOptions.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 removed the legacy ignoreEnvVarErrors type while Pro code still referenced it.
items.required_rule: D: v7 removed ignoreEnvVarErrors from Prisma internals' types; compile failed

items.change: Configured TypeScript to load local Prisma internals augmentations.
items.responds_to: The Prisma 7 compatibility augmentation needed to be visible during compilation.
items.required_rule: D: knock-on of the type augmentation fix

items.change: Included local .d.ts files in normal and validation TypeScript compilation.
items.responds_to: The Prisma 7 compatibility declarations needed to be compiled.
items.required_rule: D: knock-on of the type augmentation fix

items.change: Added a legacy-compatible getConfig declaration accepting ignoreEnvVarErrors and returning ConfigMetaFormat.
items.responds_to: Prisma 7 changed the getConfig type signature while legacy Prisma 6-compatible Pro code still passed ignoreEnvVarErrors.
items.required_rule: D: v7 changed the getConfig signature; compile failed

items.change: Raised the Node.js minimum to 20.19.0, removed Node 18 from CI, and ran the basic tests on all remaining Node versions.
Updated documented Prisma and runtime requirements to Prisma 7, Node.js 20.19+, TypeScript 5.4+, and the revised recommended versions.
items.responds_to: The project adopted Prisma 7 and its runtime requirements.

items.change: Added installed-Prisma version detection and a message for Prisma versions below 7.
items.responds_to: The release requires Prisma 7 and needs to guide Prisma 6 users to the older generator release.

items.change: Changed the unsupported-Prisma-version message from a warning to informational logging.
items.responds_to: Unsupported Prisma versions are reported as compatibility guidance rather than generator warnings.
items.required_rule: tweak of the optional guidance message

items.change: Removed use of options.version when determining the installed Prisma version and added a leading newline to the compatibility message.
items.responds_to: Version detection needed to rely on the installed Prisma package under the Prisma 7 minimum-version check.
items.required_rule: fix of the optional guidance message
